| description = The Wraith of Jaxion has a [[gyrating goo]] PH that circles the OUTSIDE portion of the third and final floating building.

If the Wraith (not PH) is up it is possible to pull him from the see-through ramp with the 3 oozes on it to the ground floor without other mobs agroing.  Start off by targeting the Wraith then get SoW (or Jboots), levitate and invis.  Then from near the top of the second section of the ramp (but below where the undead pathers can see you) run off toward the wraith (He may be pathing behind the building so you may need to float back to the top of the ramp until he's pathing toward you on the right side of the ledge).  Start spamming Tash and once it starts casting stop running and recast.  If it hits him drop down near the Lhranc building and wait for him to port to you.  Mez, charm and do your hand in.  Note that he will path back past the moat group so give them a heads up before you leave.  This may work to pull the PH as well but I didn't try it.

A second method similar to above requires use of the ramp but rather than chancing a miss, head straight to the back of the zone from the ledge (with levitate or Air illusion) of the first building on the 3rd level (top of the ramp). Run from there towards the Jaxion spawn point but left just a bit. This should place you on top of the "Moat" building with the reaver in it. You will not aggro the building. There is a flat ledge area which you can use to stop falling incase you miss it, plus a very high pointed roof where you can levitate and just past the edge, cast your tash on the roaming PH/Jaxion. Jaxion will float down to you, and you can complete this portion. This location gives you a chance to try again if you fail the first time with tash. ****NOTE**** Not sure what happens if he isn't killed from this location.

The way I did it on my level 50 enchanter was to get air illusion (for long lasting lev), IVU myself and got someone to invis me. I went upto the balcony in temple, used lev trick to get onto the flag pole, then lev trick again to get onto the 2nd floor. I ran to the top of the pointy building and then ran to the see-thru ramp. I got all the way to the floating building with the locked door. used lev trick to get on top of the door (note: just walking onto the right side fence post works), ran around the building to get to the ramp on the other side. then I just ran up to wraith, waited for the pathing for him to be out of LOS of other mobs - mezz, tash, charm and floated off to the zone in.

An easy way to do PH is to simply Allure the [[gyrating goo]] and have tell him to attack any mob on the nearby bridge. It will fall to the lower level and quickly aggro several mobs.
